extDescription.message: Turn one or many tabs into AI-ready JSON, take full-page screenshots, and export cookies, all on your device.

tagline.message: Web pages to AI-ready JSON, offline

guideStep1Body.message: The current tab is ticked for you. Tick more to extract several at once.

guideStep2Body.message: The first time, Chrome asks once to let Pagex read websites. Choose Allow and extraction starts right away; it will not ask again.

guideStep3Body.message: One page saves a JSON file; several pages save one ZIP. Nothing leaves your device.

settingAutoDownloadHint.message: Saves files as soon as they are ready while this popup is open.

settingAllSitesHint.message: Granted the first time you extract, so Chrome stops asking. Turn off to revoke.

settingAllSitesDenied.message: Chrome did not grant access to all sites.

hintBackgroundTabs.message: Background tabs are read where they are, without switching to them. Content that loads on scroll may be incomplete.

errNoUrl.message: This tab hasn't finished loading. Wait a moment and try again.

errBrowserPage.message: Browser pages such as chrome:// can't be read. Open a regular website.

errWebStore.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions read the Web Store.

errFileAccess.message: Local files need "Allow access to file URLs" turned on in Pagex's extension details.

errUnsupportedScheme.message: This kind of page can't be read.

errPermission.message: Pagex wasn't allowed to read this site. Press Extract again and choose Allow.

errNavigated.message: The page changed while it was being read. Try again once it settles.

errErrorPage.message: The page failed to load. Reload it, then try again.

errTimeout.message: The page took too long to respond. Reload it and try again.

errMainFrame.message: The page content couldn't be read.

errStorageFull.message: Too much data for one batch. Download the finished pages, then extract the rest.

errTooLarge.message: This page produced more data than Pagex can hold. Try it with fewer embedded frames open, or split the page.

errInterrupted.message: Extraction was interrupted. Press Extract to run it again.

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong while reading this page.

errPermissionDeniedAll.message: Pagex can't read these pages without access. Press Extract again and choose Allow.

errConnect.message: Couldn't reach Pagex in the background. Close and reopen this popup.

downloadFailed.message: Couldn't build the download. Try again.

runIdle.message: Tick the pages you want, then press Extract.

runIdleAuto.message: Tick the pages you want, then press Extract. Files save automatically.

runNoSelection.message: Tick at least one page above.

runOnlyUnsupported.message: None of the ticked pages can be read. See the reason under each one.

runPermission.message: Chrome is asking once for access to websites. Choose Allow and extraction starts right away, even if this popup closes.

runRunning.message: $P1$ of $P2$ finished · $P3$s. You can close this popup; work continues in the background.

runPartial.message: $P1$ of $P2$ page(s) extracted. Failed pages show the reason in the list.

runAllFailed.message: No page could be extracted. See the reason under each page.

runStopped.message: Stopped. $P1$ finished page(s) can still be downloaded.

runFinishedAway.message: Finished while the popup was closed. Download the results below.

runSelectionChanged.message: Results are from the last run. Press Extract to run the new selection.

metricClicksHint.message: Collapsed sections Pagex opened before reading

toolsHintMany.message: Tick just one page to take a screenshot or export cookies.

toolsHintNone.message: Tick one page to use these tools.

shotSavedTruncated.message: Screenshot saved. The page is very long, so only the top part fits in one image.

shotTooLarge.message: The page is too large to render as one image.

shotFailed.message: Screenshot failed. Reload the page and try again.

shotPermission.message: Permission is needed to capture this page.

cookiesDone.message: Exported $P1$ cookie(s) and $P2$ storage item(s). Keep this file private: it can sign in as you.

cookiesFailed.message: Couldn't export cookies. Check site access and try again.

cookiesPermission.message: Permission is needed to read cookies for this site.

footerPrivacy.message: Everything stays on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
